evals.prompt: We have a clickable prototype for an AI operations inbox but no user evidence. We want 20 paying teams within six months; the founders can spend 10 hours a week each. Give us a feasible roadmap.
evals.expected_output: States the prototype-only current state and capacity constraint; sequences a first observed workflow and paid-design-partner proof before repeatable acquisition; gives observable exit milestones and risks for each phase; labels unsupported timing as conditional; and ends with one direct first-phase action.
assertions: Uses a small number of ordered phases rather than a task dump
Makes live user evidence and a paid proof precede scaling acquisition
Names capacity as a constraint and avoids promising exact dates
Gives an observable exit milestone and a decision-relevant risk for every phase
Ends with an immediate move that advances the first proof

evals.prompt: I want to run a half marathon in two months. I currently run 5 km once a week and can train three times weekly, with no injury constraints. Make a feasible roadmap.
evals.expected_output: Builds a capacity-aware progression with observable check points, recovery or adaptation risk checks, and an immediate first-session move; it does not invent a medical guarantee or a detailed daily calendar.
assertions: Uses the supplied current state and three-session capacity
Organizes a progression into ordered phases with observable milestones
Names safety or adaptation conditions without pretending medical certainty
Avoids a day-by-day schedule and unsupported performance promise
Ends with a direct first-phase action
